Build one reusable price path from the existing observed price archive, using one fixed observation timestamp. The working price center is the observed historical median close-to-clock ratio applied to the latest observed prior close, with a configurable default +/-20 basis-point fill allowance and outward cent rounding. This process is automatic inside the existing nightly tail, not a duplicate schedule. It creates a planning scenario and never submits orders or assigns real manual holdings to horizon allocations. Neutral, future and missing outcomes are excluded from direction accuracy; retain cost-adjusted model scores separately. The separate immutable output is ml/gameplan-actuals-review-runs/<generation>/Gameplan-results.md, with forecast-results.parquet, price-results.parquet, report.json, a verified manifest and receipt. Report explicit pending/missing coverage. A failed actuals review resumes only that stage with the same successor and deadline, preserving successful preparation.
